title: feat(studio): match form designer/preview column density to the runtime form
body:
## Summary

In the Studio **Data → Form** view, both sub-modes misrepresented how a record's form actually renders on a wide screen:

- **Form → Layout** (`ObjectFormDesigner`) laid every section out in a **fixed `grid-cols-2`**, capped at `max-w-3xl`.
- **Form → Preview** rendered the real `ObjectForm` but wrapped it in `max-w-2xl`, so its container queries never reached 4 columns.

Meanwhile the record an end user actually edits opens in a near-full-width modal (`ModalForm` auto-sizes to `max-w-[95vw]` for 3+ column forms) and spreads to **up to 4 fields per row** on a wide screen. So the design surface showed 2 columns where reality showed 4.

This makes the designer and preview honor the same column-density rule as the runtime form.

## What changed

- **`ObjectFormDesigner`** now derives its column count exactly like the runtime form: `inferColumns()` over the object's editable (non-system) field count — the objectui#2578 "derive once, apply to every section" rule. Each section is a `@container` and its field grid uses the shared container-query classes (`containerGridColsFor` → `grid-cols-1 @md:grid-cols-2 @2xl:grid-cols-3 @4xl:grid-cols-4`), so it spreads to 4 columns on a wide panel and collapses to 1 when narrow.
- **Wide widgets** (textarea / markdown / html / …) span the full row via `col-span-full`, mirroring the form's `applyAutoColSpan` behavior. The empty-section drop placeholder spans the full row too.
- **Both canvases widened** to `max-w-6xl` so the container queries can actually reach the 4-column breakpoint.
- **`containerGridColsFor`** is now exported from `@object-ui/plugin-form` as the single source of truth for these grid classes (previously only `inferColumns` / `isWideFieldType` were public).

## Why this approach

`ObjectFormDesigner` is a WYSIWYG surface — the whole point is fidelity to what users see. Rather than duplicate the breakpoint table, it reuses the runtime form's `inferColumns` + `containerGridColsFor`, so the two can't drift. Container queries (not viewport) match the runtime form so the designer/preview respond to the panel's own width.

## Verification

- **New component test** `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx` (4 cases): 16-field object → `@4xl:grid-cols-4` present and no fixed `grid-cols-2`; light 3-field object → single column; system fields excluded from the density count; textarea → `col-span-full`, plain field not. ✅
- `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/plugin-form` — **29/29 tasks pass**. ✅
- All studio-design tests pass (33 tests, 6 files). ✅
- No live E2E in this environment (no backend available); the CSS mechanism and classes are identical to the production runtime form path, which already renders 4-column layouts.

A changeset is included (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, patch).
